instruction: A candid action photograph with a full shot captures a lively scene in an outdoor grassy park during the day. In the foreground center-left, the girl in the pink shirt and denim shorts (R1) is captured mid-backflip, her hands reaching toward the grass. In the background, three boys watch and cheer her on: the boy in the teal t-shirt (R3) stands on the left cheering with a raised fist, the boy in the neon green t-shirt (R2) stands in the center watching, and the boy in the green t-shirt (R4) celebrates on the right with both arms raised. The interaction is a joyful moment of athletic celebration. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight, highlighting the vibrant colors of their shirts against the lush green grass.
